change.title: Close the typed runtime journal writer and compatibility matrix
change.summary: Inventories every current V1/V2 runtime journal reader, writer, rollback, and clear boundary. One-click journal progress now retains the complete last persisted V2 record, so later checkpoints, success clear, and binding commit use full-record CAS and reject same-identity drift. Existing test identities cover every accepted V1 wire stage without implicit upgrade and every production-writable V2 phase or interrupted-Gateway outcome across save/load/save restart round trips. Checkpoint timing, the F5 pre-intent gap, StopFailed behavior, and journal operation scope remain unchanged.

basis: the focused one-click V2 identity rejects same-id prior-binding, compensation, and valid phase drift before later checkpoint, clear, or binding commit while preserving exact config bytes
